info.name: Sadiid Offline POS API - Complete Collection
info.description:
# 🏪 Sadiid Offline POS API - Complete Collection

This collection contains all API endpoints used by the Sadiid Offline POS application, enriched with the complete Sadiid ERP backend API documentation.

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Authentication

All endpoints require OAuth 2.0 Bearer token authentication. Start by using the Login endpoint to get your access token.

### Base URL

```
https://erp.sadiid.net/connector/api

 ```

### Environment Variables

Set up these variables in your Postman environment:

- `baseUrl`: [https://erp.sadiid.net/connector/api](https://erp.sadiid.net/connector/api)
    
- `authUrl`: [https://erp.sadiid.net/oauth/token](https://erp.sadiid.net/oauth/token)
    
- `accessToken`: (will be set automatically after login)
    
- `username`: your_username
    
- `password`: your_password
    
- `clientId`: your_client_id
    
- `clientSecret`: your_client_secret
    

## 📝 API Features

- **Authentication**: OAuth 2.0 with token refresh
    
- **Business Management**: Get business details and locations
    
- **Product Management**: CRUD operations for products and categories
    
- **Customer Management**: Full customer lifecycle management
    
- **Sales Processing**: Create, read, update sales transactions
    
- **Attendance Tracking**: Clock in/out functionality
    
- **Expense Management**: Track business expenses
    
- **Tax Management**: Handle tax calculations
    
- **Brand Management**: Product brand operations
    
- **Unit Management**: Measurement units
    
- **CRM**: Customer relationship management features
    
- **Cash Register**: Register management
    
- **Field Force**: Visit tracking
    
- **Table Management**: Restaurant table operations
    

## 🔧 Error Handling

The API returns standard HTTP status codes:

- 200: Success
    
- 201: Created
    
- 400: Bad Request
    
- 401: Unauthorized
    
- 403: Forbidden
    
- 404: Not Found
    
- 422: Validation Error
    
- 429: Rate Limited
    
- 500: Server Error
    

## 📊 Rate Limits

- Authentication: 5 requests/minute
    
- Standard endpoints: 60 requests/minute
    
- Heavy operations: 10 requests/minute

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Authenticate user and get access token for API requests.

**Required Parameters:**
- grant_type: password
- client_id: Your OAuth client ID
- client_secret: Your OAuth client secret
- username: User's username or email
- password: User's password
- scope: * (full access)

**Response:**
- access_token: Bearer token for API requests
- refresh_token: Token for refreshing access
- expires_in: Token expiration time in seconds

request.description:
Gets business configuration including:

**Business Information:**
- Company name and branding
- Currency settings and formatting
- Timezone configuration

**Locations:**
- All business locations
- Address and contact details
- Active status for each location

Gets paginated list of products with full details.

**Query Parameters:**
- page (optional): Page number (default: 1)
- per_page (optional): Items per page (default: 25, max: 500)
- location_id (optional): Filter by location
- category_id (optional): Filter by category

**Response includes:**
- Product details (name, SKU, price)
- Category information
- Variations and pricing
- Stock levels per location
- Pagination metadata

Gets paginated list of customers.

**Query Parameters:**
- type: "customer" or "supplier"
- page (optional): Page number
- per_page (optional): Items per page

**Response includes:**
- Customer contact information
- Address details
- Contact status
- Unique contact ID

Creates a new customer contact.

**Required Fields:**
- type: "customer"
- first_name: Customer's first name
- last_name: Customer's last name

**Optional Fields:**
- email: Email address
- mobile: Phone number
- address_line_1: Street address
- city, state, country, zip_code: Location details

**Response:**
- Complete customer record with generated ID
- Unique contact_id for reference

Creates a new sale transaction.

**Required Fields:**
- contact_id: Customer ID
- location_id: Business location ID
- transaction_date: Sale date and time
- final_total: Total sale amount
- status: "final" for completed sale
- products: Array of sale items
- payments: Array of payment methods

**Product Fields:**
- product_id: Product ID
- variation_id: Product variation ID
- quantity: Quantity sold
- unit_price: Price per unit

**Payment Fields:**
- amount: Payment amount
- method: Payment method (cash, card, etc.)

**Response:**
- Complete sale record with server-generated ID
- Invoice number and URL
- All sale lines and payment details

Gets paginated list of sales transactions.

**Query Parameters:**
- page (optional): Page number
- per_page (optional): Items per page
- location_id (optional): Filter by location
- contact_id (optional): Filter by customer
- start_date (optional): Filter by date range (YYYY-MM-DD)
- end_date (optional): Filter by date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

**Response includes:**
- Sale summary information
- Customer details
- Payment status
- Invoice numbers and totals

Gets detailed information for a specific sale.

**Path Parameters:**
- saleId: The ID of the sale to retrieve

**Response includes:**
- Complete sale details
- All sale line items
- Payment information
- Customer details
- Invoice URL if available

Updates an existing sale transaction.

**Path Parameters:**
- saleId: The ID of the sale to update

**Request Body:**
Same structure as Create Sale endpoint

**Note:**
This will completely replace the existing sale data with the provided information.

Gets list of product categories.

**Response includes:**
